received_works.body:
Hello! I love your artwork very much!

I would like to request two illustrations of my VTuber character that will be featured in a YouTube song cover video(1920 x 1080).

Character details:
- Sleepy fox girl
- White hair
- Blue eyes with hints of yellow
- Fox ears with different inner colors (one pink, one yellow)

Art direction:
- Rainy, moody atmosphere
- Dark / muted color palette
- Emotional and quiet feeling

Composition idea for the first illustration:
- Sitting alone under an umbrella

Composition idea for the second illustration:
- Close-up of her looking down sadly in the rain

Expression:
- Tired, melancholic, gentle sadness

Outfit:
- You are welcome to change her outfit to better fit the theme.

Framing:
- Either bust-up or half-body preferred

If possible, I would really appreciate a transparent background version as well.
Thank you very much for your time and consideration!
